title: To name the Department of Veterans Affairs community-based outpatient clinic in Auburn, California, as the "Louis A. Conter VA Clinic".
official_summary: This act designates the community-based outpatient clinic of the Department of Veterans Affairs in Auburn, California, as the Louis A. Conter VA Clinic.

summary.headline: Congress named a VA outpatient clinic in Auburn, California, the Louis A. Conter VA Clinic.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the Department of Veterans Affairs community-based outpatient clinic in Auburn, California. The new name honors Louis A. Conter. It does not change the clinic's services, staffing, or hours.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 4, 2025.
